Type:        NORMALIZER
Name:        Normalizer
Category:    transformers
Description: Receives data through connected input port, splits each data record into more records and sends all resulting records to all connected output ports.
Usage:       When to use: Split ONE input record into a variable number of output records determined at runtime (e.g. expand a list field, unpack a delimited string into individual rows). CTL entry: count() returns how many records to produce, transform(integer idx) produces record at index idx.
             Constraints: Purpose-built for 1→N. Prefer over REFORMAT for this pattern — cleaner CTL, explicit count/transform separation.

Input Ports:
  [0] (required)
Output Ports:
  [0] (required)

Properties:
  Conditional required groups:
    normalize | normalizeClass | normalizeURL (at least one is required; mutually exclusive)

  normalize [attr-cdata]: [transformNormalize]  Configures normalize.
  normalizeURL: [file]  Specifies the path or URL for normalize url.
  normalizeClass: [class]  Configures normalize class.
  charset: [charset]  Defines the character encoding used to encode/decode file content. If not specified, the system will attempt to detect or use the default encoding.
  errorActions [attr-cdata]: [errorActions]  Defines the actions to take when errors occur during processing.
  errorLog: [file]  Specifies the file where error information should be logged.

To configure it, call component_get_guide("NORMALIZER") — full attribute reference with allowed values, defaults, and worked mapping/transform examples this surface view omits. Don't re-run component_get_info on the same type; if the properties above aren't enough, escalate to component_get_guide.
